note: xmlParseAttValueComplex() (parser.c) ends its whitespace-normalization pass with `while (buf[len - 1] == 0x20) len--;` -- buf is the heap-allocated attribute-value translation buffer and len (a size_t, declared 0) is only ever incremented while copying characters into it. The guard that reaches this statement (`in_space && normalize`) does not itself guarantee len > 0: for a crafted attribute value whose content is entirely consumed by entity/character-reference processing without ever appending a character to buf, the loop reaches this line with len still 0, so len - 1 wraps to SIZE_MAX (size_t underflow) and the read walks before the start of the heap allocation -- a buffer underflow.

traces.message: size_t len = 0; -- len defaults to and can remain 0 through the parse loop above (only buf[len++]/COPY_BUF paths increment it)
buf[len - 1] : read with no len>0 guard -- underflows to buf[SIZE_MAX] when len is still 0.
